description: This Java class 'FiringOrderTSLogic' reads firing order configurations from a header file, processes the data, and generates logic expressions for ignition timing based on the cylinder firing order. It includes methods for reading and parsing the firing order data, and for generating firing logic for specified cylinder IDs.

classes.name: FiringOrderTSLogic
classes.description: A utility class for reading firing order data from a header file, processing this data, and producing ignition control logic for engine cylinders.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that loads firing orders and processes cylinder IDs from 2 to 12.

methods.name: readFiringOrders
methods.description: Reads the firing order definitions from an external header file and populates the map 'ordinal2order'.

methods.name: processId
methods.description: Generates and prints out logic expressions for a specific cylinder ID based on the loaded firing orders.
